request: Please find me data regarding first-of-class ship cost overruns

reply.reply:
**A CBO analysis summarized by CRS estimated the first 10 FFG-62 frigates would cost 40% more to build than Navy estimates; the lead ship estimate was $1,499.3 million.**

- A CBO analysis released in October 2020 estimated that the first 10 FFG-62 frigates would cost 40% more to build than the Navy estimates. (R44972, PDF p. 39)
- The lead ship had an estimated procurement cost of $1,499.3 million (about $1.5 billion), partly because its cost includes much of the class’s detailed design/nonrecurring engineering costs. (R44972, PDF p. 10)
- CRS reports that cost growth for Ford-class ships is shown in Table 2. (RS20643, PDF p. 15)
reply.reasoning: The clearest quantified comparison found is the CBO estimate for the first 10 FFG-62s, reported in recent CRS coverage. The lead-ship procurement estimate is separate from the overrun comparison and includes much of the class’s detailed design and nonrecurring engineering costs.
